title.zh-CN: 箱内仰视农场广告海报

description.zh-CN: 生成从纸箱内部向上仰视的概念广告海报，通过强透视开口、动物探头和底部品牌文案表达新鲜直达的产品卖点。
description.en-US: Look up from inside a produce box for a playful farm advertising scene.

zh-CN.prompt:
创建一张 3:4 竖版概念广告海报。镜头位于打开的牛皮纸箱底部，以第一人称视角垂直向上拍摄。四面纸箱内壁以强烈单点透视汇聚到画面顶部中央的方形开口，纸板保留瓦楞、折痕、磨损和真实阴影。

开口外是明亮浅蓝天空和少量白云。两只 `{animalType}` 从开口左右两侧好奇地探头向下看，眼神友好，距离略有差异，形成自然不对称和尺度反差。阳光从开口照入，照亮纸板上缘，主体清晰，近处纸箱略微虚化。

海报底部在纸板区域排布大号标题“{headline}”、两行卖点“{supportingCopy}”、小型原创品牌标识“{brandName}”、配送或产地信息以及极细页脚。标题使用粗体现代无衬线字体，正文使用中等字重，元信息使用带字距的大写字体。

配色以牛皮纸棕、天空蓝、自然主体色、炭黑和柔和灰为主。整体要像成熟创意广告：概念一眼可懂、留白充足、文字可读、摄影质感真实，不出现真实品牌或水印。

en-US.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 conceptual advertising poster. Position the camera at the bottom of an open kraft-cardboard box, looking straight upward in first-person perspective. The four inner walls converge in strong single-point perspective toward the square opening at the top center. Preserve corrugation, creases, wear, and realistic shadows in the cardboard.

Beyond the opening, show a bright pale blue sky with a few white clouds. Two `{animalType}` curiously peer down from opposite sides of the opening with friendly eyes, at slightly different distances for natural asymmetry and scale contrast. Sunlight enters through the opening and illuminates the upper cardboard edges. Keep the subjects clear and the nearby box slightly out of focus.

In the lower cardboard area, arrange a large headline "{headline}", two lines of selling points "{supportingCopy}", a small original brand mark "{brandName}", shipping or origin information, and a very fine footer. Use bold modern sans-serif for the headline, medium weight for body text, and spaced uppercase lettering for metadata.

Favor kraft brown, sky blue, natural subject colors, charcoal, and soft gray. The result should resemble a mature creative advertisement: an immediately understandable concept, ample negative space, readable text, and realistic photography, without real brands or watermarks.
